about: The inputs the hdf4 profile rejects, each with the start of its message, in the order of the checks of spec/zarrify/hdf4.md (its section 8.3, Checks). rust/refkv-ir/build.rs writes a Rust test per case into tests/hdf4.rs; python/tests/ir/test_rejects.py checks each through the host and that every rejected fixture is listed here.

cases.host: not a file of any supported format

cases.message: the descriptor block at byte 4 runs past the end of the file
the descriptor block at byte 4 has -2 descriptors
the descriptor blocks loop at byte 4
tag 106 ref 23 (4 bytes at byte 12425) runs past the end of the file
the special element tag 17086 ref 5 has the unknown code 9
the compressed element tag 17086 ref 5 holds its data in a special element other than linked blocks
the link tables of tag 18347 ref 6 loop
the chunk table of tag 17086 ref 5 places a chunk at [9, 0], outside its grid [2, 2]
